content.text:
**Six more possible wrong fires:** a scan of past transcripts found six more matches the hook would still treat as codes. None has blocked a turn yet. They are month-day dates like "10-31 handoff", money ranges like "$30–58", and one quoted question. It is now making a second commit. Two ranges side by side will block only when the reply also tells you to answer with them; a bare "1-4 accept, 5-6 S" with no such instruction will no longer block.

The inbox coder in the worktree is still running.
